title: 第19章 唐梦宫的做事风格第20章 S级生存难度
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 林安前面那位小太监将手中盘子轻轻摆放到唐梦宫面前。
盘中菜点精美异常，散发着氤氲灵气，香气格外的浓郁。
这是一道大菜—龙肝烩凤髓！
小太监正欲躬身退去，眼神忽然变得恍惚起来。
口中不自觉地低语。
“龙肝与凤髓都是顶尖食材，彼此可完美搭配，制作出最最顶级菜式。”
“但，若将二者其一与普通蔬菜相搭，则食性相冲，很难端上餐桌。”
唐梦宫握筷子的手指一顿，抬起眼皮，目光冰冷地瞥了眼小太监。
一旁的剑侍见状，顿时将剑尖抵在了说话的小太监咽喉。
“放肆！敢在梦妃面前胡言乱语！”
“我斩了你！”
小太监仿佛没有察觉，脸上没有一丁点的表情。
“退下。”唐梦宫轻喝一声。
剑侍闻声，赶忙收剑退去。
唐梦宫凝视着小太监，“你刚说的话是何意？”
小太监神色麻木，宛如木偶般应答。
“食材有等级之分，人类亦然！”
“梦妃娘娘乃天之骄女，相伴之人理应是纵横世天地的大人物，些许污泥只会阻碍人您的脚步，不值得您驻足留恋叹息。”
唐梦宫的眼神变了。
眉眼间不再是纯粹的冰冷，而是多了一抹极其隐晦的震动与思索。
“你是何人！”她审视着小太监道。
“请娘娘清退左右。”
“所有人退下。”
“是，主人。”
院中人群很快散去，只剩下了唐梦宫与小太监二人。
小太监自顾自地坐在了旁边椅子上，手指蘸了点酒水，在石桌上龙飞凤舞地书写了起来。
唐梦宫面露疑色，盯着小太监的动作。
当看清桌上文字之时，她神色一震，身上剑气险些失控。
“这是…本小姐剑术瓶颈的突破方式？”
小太监僵硬一笑。
“娘娘好眼力！这是给您的诚意！”
唐梦宫死盯着小太监的眼睛。
“你到底是何人？来此处又有何目的！！”
“娘娘，我是何人不重要，重要的是，不想看到娘娘因一个废人而陷入自我怀疑。”
唐梦宫冷着眼，“你一个太监，敢称呼大夏帝王为废人？”
“娘娘息怒，你我并非敌对！我知道娘娘嫁给云江仙是为了大夏龙运，如今您失了宠，不如你我合作一番如何？”
“放肆！！”唐梦宫骤然爆发，“大夏龙运岂是你一个阉人能觊觎的！”
content_en:
The little eunuch in front of Lin An gently placed the plate in front of Tang Menggong.
The dishes on the plate are extremely exquisite, exuding a dense aura, and the aroma is particularly rich.
This is a great dish—dragon liver braised with phoenix marrow!
The little eunuch was about to bow and retreat, when his eyes suddenly became trance-like.
He whispered unconsciously.
"Dragon liver and phoenix marrow are both top-notch ingredients, and they can be perfectly paired with each other to create the most top-notch dishes."
"However, if one of the two is paired with ordinary vegetables, the food habits will conflict and it will be difficult to serve on the table."
Tang Menggong paused with his fingers holding the chopsticks, raised his eyelids, and glanced at the little eunuch with a cold gaze.
When the sword attendant on the side saw this, he immediately put the tip of his sword at the throat of the young eunuch who was speaking.
"Presumptuous! How dare you talk nonsense in front of Concubine Meng!"
"I'll kill you!"
The little eunuch didn't seem to notice, with no expression on his face.
"Back off." Tang Menggong shouted softly.
The sword attendant heard the sound and quickly put away his sword and retreated.
Tang Menggong stared at the little eunuch, "What did you mean by what you just said?"
The little eunuch looked numb and responded like a puppet.
"Foods have levels, and so do humans!"
"Meng Fei is a proud daughter of heaven, and the person accompanying her should be a big shot in the world. A little mud will only hinder your steps, and it is not worth your stop and sigh."
Tang Menggong's eyes changed.
There is no longer pure coldness between the eyebrows and eyes, but a touch of extremely obscure shock and thinking.
"Who are you!" she asked, looking at the little eunuch.
"Please, the empress, please clear the left and right sides."
"Everyone stand down."
"Yes, Master."
The crowd in the courtyard quickly dispersed, leaving only Tang Menggong and the young eunuch.
The little eunuch sat on the chair next to him minding his own business, dipped his fingers in some wine, and started writing on the stone table.
Tang Menggong looked suspicious and stared at the little eunuch's movements.
When she saw the words on the table clearly, her expression was shocked, and her sword energy almost lost control.
"Is this... my way of breaking through the bottleneck of my swordsmanship?"
The little eunuch smiled stiffly.
"Your Majesty, you have good eyesight! This is your sincerity!"
Tang Menggong stared into the little eunuch's eyes.
"Who are you? What's the purpose of coming here!!"
"My queen, it doesn't matter who I am. What's important is that I don't want to see my queen fall into self-doubt because of a useless person."
Tang Menggong looked coldly, "You, a eunuch, dare to call the Emperor of Great Xia a useless person?"
"Your Majesty, please calm down. We are not hostile! I know that your Majesty married Yunjiang Immortal for the sake of the Great Xia Dragon Luck. Now that you have lost your favor, how about you and I working together?"
"Presumptuous!!" Tang Menggong suddenly exploded, "How can a eunuch like you covet the Great Xia Dragon Luck!"
